title: Cratis Cast registry
description: Reviewed Core and Partner members of the Cratis Cast. Contributor is computed, never listed.

github.description: GitHub login. Unique in the file, compared case-insensitively.

tier.description: core: founders and maintainers. partner: consultants and companies Cratis vouches for.

since.description: When the membership started, YYYY-MM. Leave out when unknown.

role.description: Role in relation to Cratis, as shown on the verification page.

site.description: The member's site, linked from the directory. The directory reads its /cast.json unless profile says otherwise.

profile.description: URL of the member's cast.json (format version 2), when it is not at <site>/cast.json. The directory renders the full profile from it.
